headline: Performance Marketing Leadership | Portfolio Strategy | Growth Economics
headline_rationale: CSC prioritizes cross-brand paid strategy, incremental economics, budgets, team building and commercial recommendations. Master supports large budgets, multi-company PPC transformation, teams and investment analysis; do not invent 13-brand P&L ownership or leadership-of-managers tenure.
summary: Performance marketing leader combining portfolio operating systems, investment analysis and hands-on e-commerce execution. Built an in-house PPC structure for a group spanning 32 businesses, consolidating agency work and developing the team and reporting system. Analyzed incremental CPA, lifetime value and channel trade-offs, and used regression modeling to guide a proposed additional $10 million investment. Led an eight-person e-commerce team, coordinated cross-functional priorities and scaled monthly marketing volume fourfold while improving ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5.
factual_review: Read exact CSC Generation VP Performance Marketing posting, US remote eligibility and SLC interview hub. Current master supports Any Hour32business scope, E002/E004/E010/E093/E037/E060/E038. No claimed 13brandportfolio, executive P&L ownership or unverified managerial tenure.
tools_rationale: Supported channel, analytics, commerce and AI tools relevant to portfolio-level planning and hands-on judgment.
